title: Right Beside Your Heart
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The high and holy One lives up
Above the tallest hill;
Yet He comes close to humble hearts
That feel so small and still.

[Chorus]
Peace, peace, to all so far away,
And peace to all so near;
He lives up high and right beside
Your quiet heart, right here.

[Verse 2]
Beau bumped a plant; it tipped and fell,
He swept the dirt from sight;
His tummy ached, so he told Dad
And made the whole thing right.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
We can puff up and act so big,
Or tell the truth instead;
He lifts the humble heart back up
And heals it, like He said.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
Fold both your hands beneath your chin,
Say, "Here's my heart, I'm small;"
The One who lives above the sky
Comes close and hears it all.

[Chorus]
mood: Settling music. A slow, even pulse under the voice, like a child curled up small who takes one deep breath and is lifted. Fingerpicked nylon guitar keeps the pulse low and close, and a cello answers it from underneath, the two in quiet conversation, one high and one near. Honest rather than sad, each verse a little lighter than the last, the final chorus opening out like a heart that has finally told the whole thing.
